subject: Fall 2026 CE Deadline Reminder
snippet: This is a reminder that the 2026 CE reporting deadline is December 31 2026...
body:
Dear IFSI Participant,

This is a reminder that the 2026 CE reporting deadline is December 31, 2026. All Illinois fire service personnel must complete their required continuing education hours by this date.

Visit the IFSI portal to verify your current CE hour balance and browse our Fall 2026 course catalog.

Questions? Contact ce-help@ifsi.edu or call (217) 555-0100.

IFSI Continuing Education Office

snippet: How's the studying coming along? Saw your results...

subject: Q4 Equipment Inspection Week — Oct 24-30
snippet: The Q4 Equipment Inspection Week is scheduled for October 24-30...
body:
All Station 47 Personnel,

The Q4 Equipment Inspection Week is scheduled for October 24-30, 2026. All apparatus, SCBA units, PPE, and medical equipment must pass inspection. Engine 81 and Truck 27 are scheduled for full NFPA 1911 inspection.

Key requirements:
- All pump testing completed by Oct 27
- SCBA flow tests Oct 24-25
- PPE inventory due to Battalion by Oct 29

Overtime shifts may be required during this period. See your Captain for scheduling details.

MCFR Human Resources
Division of Training & Safety
